latest_news.headline: Hormuz closure claims collide with live traffic evidence
latest_news.text: Bloomberg reported three Indian tankers reemerging and Business Standard/IndexBox said oil traffic persisted while NYT, BBC and energy feeds carried renewed Iranian closure claims. Risk stays critical, but open-flow evidence blocks a zero-flow or obstruction upgrade.

latest_news.headline: Israel-Lebanon truce strain worsens after reported new attacks and casualties
latest_news.text: Al Jazeera, BBC, Jerusalem Post, Kurdistan24, Arab Weekly and Daily Sabah reported new Israeli attacks, Hezbollah activity and Lebanese casualty claims. Existing combat-breach pressure remains active and the restoration channel is not yet controlling events.

latest_news.headline: Iran nuclear track remains mixed: talks revive while material/damage questions persist
latest_news.text: The Observer highlighted missing-material uncertainty; Times of Israel and RFE/RL reported US-Iran talks revived; UN News previously said technical work could begin; public imagery reporting described site damage. No verified new threshold activity surfaced in this scan.

latest_news.headline: Pakistan-Afghanistan border pressure stays near ceiling
latest_news.text: Modern Diplomacy, Afghanistan International, Al Jazeera, Express Tribune, Arab News, KabulNow, NDTV, Indian Express and Rising Nepal reported or discussed Afghan/Taliban-claimed strikes, Pakistani denials, roadside bombs and open-war language. No new configured signal was added.

latest_news.headline: Gaza/Jerusalem stress remains high without wider breakout
latest_news.text: UN Press kept Gaza humanitarian/security pressure visible; Arab News reported a Gaza statement at the Security Council; BBC kept Jerusalem holy-site status-quo pressure visible; Zeteo and regional feeds reported Gaza/West Bank violence. No wider-regional breakout indicator surfaced.

latest_news.headline: Allied-position review finds posture debate, not direct Russia-NATO entry
latest_news.text: Stars and Stripes, Kyiv Post, Daily Sabah, London Business News and NATO-indexed headlines showed European posture debate, Ankara summit planning and Kremlin warning commentary. No Article 5 activation, allied combat-entry decision or verified Russia-NATO kinetic incident surfaced.

latest_news.headline: Ukraine war remains ceiling stress; no allied direct-entry breakpoint
latest_news.text: MSN live reporting said the Kremlin would not accept a European ultimatum, while Eurasia Review carried Russian nuclear-coercion analysis. The scan did not surface an allied direct-combat decision or Article 5 breakpoint.

latest_news.headline: Energy sanity check supports Hormuz risk but not total stoppage
latest_news.text: Energy News Beat, Kavout, Business Standard, Discovery Alert and IndexBox showed Hormuz risk premium and closure-claim coverage while oil kept flowing. Local cache before deploy showed Brent $80.38 from 19 Jun and WTI $76.54 from 21 Jun 12:45Z; EIA Today in Energy was reachable but not Hormuz-specific.

latest_news.headline: Indo-Pacific posture item: Typhon-in-Japan headline below auto-add threshold
latest_news.text: Defence Security Asia reported a U.S. Typhon mid-range system deployment to Japan; Taiwan-window commentary also appeared in The Diplomat and other feeds. This reinforces posture concern but is single-source for auto-detection and did not show a live blockade or invasion-prep breakout.

latest_news.headline: Sudan/El Obeid risk persists; fresh coverage thinner than earlier UN warning run
latest_news.text: IDN-InDepthNews carried EEPA reporting on RSF mobilisation around El Obeid; earlier UN/UNSC and regional warnings remain the core evidence. No Red Sea spillover or direct external-state entry surfaced.

latest_news.headline: DPRK no-trigger review: single Yellow Sea firing headline remains uncorroborated
latest_news.text: Bloomberg, UPI, SCMP, Kyodo/Japan Wire, The Diplomat and AEI mostly returned nuclear-status, deterrence and regional analysis; a single MSN Yellow Sea firing headline was not enough to promote a configured signal.

latest_news.headline: India-Pakistan review remains elevated but no fresh combat trigger
latest_news.text: Stratfor, Defence Security Asia, Asia Sentinel, ORF and regional feeds focused on Indus/water, defence posture and analysis. No fresh verified Line of Control combat or immediate force-posture breakout surfaced.
